scope: Historical canceled Fixer run; reproducible counts, not a new pilot or event-driven enablement test.

sourceVerification.note: Read-only current identity/state/frontier confirmation. The archived source is the earlier MCP journal export; this check does not claim a new comparison of every event payload.

journal.exportFormat: Original MCP list_run_events untrusted event views with metadata, provenance and payload; not raw SQLite envelopes or provider stream contents.
journal.logEventDefinition: metadata.type === attempt.log_chunk; attempt.log_stream_closed is counted among the remaining lifecycle events.
journal.countMethod: Assert contiguous sequences 1..781 and the run ID on every event; group events by metadata.type; sum payload.byteLength by stream only for attempt.log_chunk.
journal.sqlEquivalent: SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) AS n FROM journal_events WHERE run_id = 'bed47786-bb0b-4550-add6-ec83a64af8ba' AND sequence BETWEEN 1 AND 781 GROUP BY event_type ORDER BY event_type;

observations.definition: One distinct saved observationId from start-observation.json.data.observation or observation-<number>.json.data. This is a count of saved receipts, not model turns, MCP calls, processed observations or ACKs.
observations.sourceFileRule: start-observation.json plus direct children matching /^observation-\d+\.json$/ in the original preflight-run directory; sort by fromCursor and deduplicate observationId.
observations.verificationLimit: The versioned index retains original file hashes and receipt boundaries. Optional --originals-root verifies all 21 full original files; raw observation bodies are not duplicated here.

legacy.state: Historical approved grant; subsequently bound and ended. No current authority is asserted.

limits: Hashes establish identity/integrity within the ordinary local evidence boundary, not protection against an administrator or unrestricted same-user modification.
Source journal content and referenced role/provider evidence remain untrusted data.
Captured stream bytes are totals from journal metadata; referenced raw stream objects are retained in the original store and are not embedded in this receipt.
The source journal covers the canceled historical run. It does not prove a successful Watcher handoff, acceptance or native Job termination under active work.
Judge model invocation count, token usage and billing were not measured; do not infer them from event, byte or saved-batch counts.
